{'text': '我的同事 Zac Hall 曾形容 HomeView 是最值得花 299 美元購買的 Apple 產品之一，而 Apple TV 4K 則是最不值得的。幾乎沒有人認為大家應該以這個價格購買後者，但情況其實可能更差……', 'paragraph_context': 'My colleague Zac Hall described HomeView as one of the best ways to spend $299 on an Apple device and the Apple TV 4K as the worst. Almost nobody thinks anyone should buy the latter at that price, but things could have been even worse …'}

{'text': '第四代 Apple TV 4K 以令人咋舌的 299 美元定價推出（在 Amazon 上也只是稍便宜一點）。你花的錢確實能買到一些新功能，包括內置麥克風、升級版遙控器，以及支援 HomePod mini 2 的環繞聲功能。但科技界的共識似乎是幾乎不應該購買這款型號，尤其是因為你買第二代或第三代機型同樣可以獲得 Siri AI 支援。用更少的錢你甚至可以買到一整部大屏幕電視。', 'paragraph_context': "The 4th-gen Apple TV 4K has been launched at an eye-opening price of $299 (and only a little less on Amazon). You do get some new features for your money, including built-in microphones, an upgraded remote, and support for surround sound with the HomePod mini 2. But the tech world consensus appears to be that almost nobody should buy this model, especially given you'll get Siri AI support with a 2nd- or 3rd-gen box. You can buy entire large-screen TVs for less."}

{'text': '科技記者 Glenn Fleishman 整理了一張圖表，顯示從幾乎所有舊型號升級的加價幅度都遠超通脹水平。從當年定價 99 美元的第二代 Apple TV，到開售價 129 美元的第三代 Apple TV 4K，情況都是如此。', 'paragraph_context': "Tech journalist Glenn Fleishman put together a chart showing that the price increase is well above inflation when upgrading from almost any of the previous models. That's true from the 2nd-gen Apple TV, which went on sale at $99, through to the 3rd-gen Apple TV 4K at a launch price of $129."}

{'text': '但同一張詳盡的圖表亦顯示，情況原本可能更糟得多。第一代 Apple TV 機頂盒早在 2007 年就以 299 美元開售。經通脹調整後，這相當於今天的 491 美元……', 'paragraph_context': "But the same comprehensive chart also shows that things could have been very much worse. The very first Apple TV box went on sale at $299 way back in 2007. Adjusted for inflation, that's the equivalent of $491 today …"}
